visuals.heading: Scope and Salary Answer, Upfront

items.text: Home healthcare and telehealth physiotherapy are genuinely growing employer categories right now, alongside the traditional clinic, hospital, and sports-team routes.
"Physiotherapist" is not one job.

blocks.heading: BPT and MPT: the Real Course Structure

items.text: The Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) is the entry-level professional degree, regulated under the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP).

A Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) is a further 2-year postgraduate degree pursued after BPT, letting you specialise in orthopedics, neurology, sports physiotherapy, pediatrics, cardiopulmonary physiotherapy, or musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
Most guides present BPT-then-MPT as an automatic next step.

blocks.heading: Ortho, Pediatric: the 4 Tracks That Matter

items.text: Post-surgical rehab, joint replacements, back pain, and sports-adjacent soft-tissue injuries.
Stroke recovery, spinal cord injury, Parkinson's, and cerebral palsy rehab.

blocks.heading: Mistakes That Flatten a Physiotherapy Career

items.text: Most disappointing outcomes in this field come from planning decisions, not from lack of clinical skill.
A fresher in a small-town private clinic and a senior sports-team physio are not on the same pay curve.
Sports physio gets the visibility, but ortho/musculoskeletal and neuro rehab carry far more job volume and steadier income in the first five years.

blocks.heading: Next If You Are Serious About Physiotherapy

items.text: Do not decide between sports, neuro, ortho, and pediatric physiotherapy in the abstract, and do not lock in a college choice based on last year's NEET assumption.
Shortlist one or two specializations that match how you actually like to work, fast-paced and high-stakes, or steady and relationship-driven, before comparing salary tables.
Verify the current-year NEET and admission requirement for BPT directly on the NCAHP portal or your target college's official notice, close to the admission window.

Rs 3-5 LPA entry-level sports-physio roles; national-team or senior IPL-level roles pay considerably more, but these are a tiny number of seats
High visibility and prestige, but requires an MPT in sports physiotherapy plus certifications, and seats are genuinely scarce
Home healthcare platforms
Per-visit or salaried models; per-visit rates commonly Rs 400-900 per session depending on city and platform, salaried roles closer to clinic-level pay
Flexible scheduling and growing demand, but travel time between visits and inconsistent case load in the first few months

blocks.heading: MPT Salary Per Month
rows: Government hospitals (central and state, ESIC, defence)

The one figure with an official source: central-government physiotherapist posts, such as ESIC and the central armed police forces, are placed at Level 6 of the 7th Pay Commission matrix, a scale of Rs 35,400 to Rs 1,12,400 a month in basic pay, before allowances (replies in the Lok Sabha; a Group B notice from a central rehabilitation institute shows the same level). Some institutes still advertise older pay bands.

The level belongs to the post, and the notices we found ask for a bachelor's degree, so an MPT does not raise the starting pay level by itself. Take-home depends on allowances and city. Read the pay matrix in the specific recruitment notice. Posts are few and competitive.
Large private or corporate hospitals
No official or audited figure exists. Career sites and college blogs quote widely different ranges, from very low fresher pay to several tens of thousands for experienced therapists.
Treat any single number as a rumour. Check live job listings in your city and ask people working in the role. Fresher pay is modest in most private settings.
Clinics, rehab centres and sports academies
No reliable public figure; sources disagree.
Highly variable. Income depends on patient load, referrals and your reputation.
Own clinic, home visits or tele-rehab
No reliable public figure. It can be above or below a salary depending on patients and costs.
The only setting where income is not capped by an employer's pay band.

visuals.heading: NEET Question for 2026-27

items.text: NCAHP originally proposed making NEET-UG the common entrance exam for BPT and BOT (Bachelor of Occupational Therapy) admissions starting the 2026-27 academic year.
After pushback from institutions, students, and professional bodies including the Indian Association of Physiotherapists, NCAHP deferred the NEET-mandatory requirement to the 2027-28 academic year.

For the 2026-27 admission cycle, most institutions are admitting through a merit list based on aggregate Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, and Biology marks (commonly a minimum 50% aggregate), not NEET scores.
An MPT specialization in a high-demand track like sports, neuro, or orthopedics.
Moving from a small standalone clinic into a corporate hospital chain or a specialised rehabilitation centre.
Certifications that widen your scope, dry needling, kinesio-taping, manual therapy credentials, or a sports-rehabilitation certificate.
Years of hands-on case volume in a specific specialization, not just years since graduation.
